text:
Irene (sec): heads-up: planning a base-image cutover next Thu. Need alignment on RBAC for the image-bake SA, KMS key placement for cosign, and audit retention. want to avoid a rollback scramble.
Alex (eng): quick note: our bake jobs run in shared CI runners, not a dedicated builder pod. scoping RBAC to runners is risky.
Ted (infra): proposed minimal perms: grant image-builder SA `storage.objects.get` + `storage.objects.create` on the build-bucket and only `iam.serviceAccounts.actAs` for the cosign signer role. keeps blast radius small.
Sachin (security): two compliance asks: (1) do we store cosign-wrapped key material in central KMS or per-env keys? (2) audit retention must be 1y for artifacts and signature writes (not 30d).
Linda (oncall): +1 for 1y retention. add an alert for signature-write failures — last time an IAM deny slipped by.
deploy-bot: build/998712 started by @alex (eng)
Alex (eng): ops leans toward a central key with tight admin group; easier monitoring and rotation. downside: single key is a potential single point.
Irene (sec): hybrid suggestion: central key with per-environment KEKs. image-builder SA gets Encrypt/Decrypt on per-env key only; keystore-admin group retains central key control. thoughts?
Sachin (security): fine with that. require cosign to use KMS-backed key versions (no local key files). gating should reject unsigned images.
Ted (infra): infra plan draft:
- create `projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/image-signing/cryptoKeys/prod-image-signer`
- grant `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter` to `svc-image-builder@redwood` on that key
- restrict `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyAdmin` to `grp-keystore-admin@redwood`
Alex (eng): registry IAM: create a registry-scoped role with IAM condition so only `svc-image-builder` can upload to `image-bucket/prod/` prefix. avoids giving all runners write access.
Irene (sec): how do we handle rollbacks that require re-signing older images? who can re-sign?
Sachin (security): only keystore-admins. require JIT approval and log approval to the audit trail. also add `principalSet` deny in the bucket policy for SAs outside `svc-image-builder`.
Linda (oncall): add alerts: KMS usage spikes, cosign sign errors, and a runbook in #incidents. set the pager threshold low for signature failures.
Alex (eng): cosign note: KMS signing needs the key version resource path. example we tested: `cosign sign --kms projects/.../cryptoKeys/.../cryptoKeyVersions/1 gcr.io/redwood/app@sha256:...`
Irene (sec): action items (owners + ETAs):
- Ted: provision per-env KMS key ring + grants (ETA Tue)
- Alex: change registry IAM to condition on `svc-image-builder` and update CI to use that SA for prod bakes (ETA Wed)
- Sachin: add gating rule to reject unsigned images; design JIT re-sign flow (ETA Thu)
- Linda: create alerts + incident runbook for KMS/sign failures (ETA Wed)
- Irene: write short RFC and compliance checklist (audit retention 1y) and open follow-up PRs (ETA Mon)
Sachin (security): small nit: include explicit deny for principals outside the allowed SA in the bucket policy to reduce accidental writes.
Ted (infra): will add a test that simulates an IAM deny and validates alerting.
Irene (sec): treating this thread as canonical preflight. if no objections I'll open the RFC and tag owners. :thumbsup:
